# Requirements Quality Checklist: Enforcement Result Notification Email (CIMD-4548, CIMD-4543)

**Purpose**: Broad, lightweight pre-`/speckit.plan` sanity check of spec.md's requirements quality (completeness,
clarity, consistency, measurability, coverage) — scoped to this feature's own internal functional requirements,
not the three external dependency contracts (`enforcement_area`, doc-generator, gov-uk-notify-gateway), which are
covered separately in `research.md`/`contracts/`.
**Created**: 2026-11-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and
requirements. It follows a session that reversed FR-011/FR-012's reshare-gating rule and resolved four other
ambiguities via `/speckit.clarify` — several items below specifically probe for residual inconsistency from that
rewrite, alongside a broader pass over the rest of the spec.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for a relatedReferenceNumber that resolves to a malformed/non-numeric
      Division Code, as distinct from "no match" (FR-006)? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for a hearing with zero offences in its current (post-amendment) state
      (e.g. full case withdrawal)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Is there a requirement distinguishing "the FR-011 gate could not be evaluated" (e.g. hearing data
      temporarily unavailable) from "the gate was evaluated and found no match"? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for amend-reshare events for the same relatedReferenceNumber arriving
      out of order (e.g. due to retry/network delay)? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "captured result shortCode" (FR-001) precise enough to say whether adjournment or
      non-final results count? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "the hearing's current (post-amendment) state" (FR-011) precise about which data source is
      authoritative at gate-evaluation time? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "immediately preceding share" (FR-009) unambiguous for the case where the preceding event was
      itself gated out by FR-011 (no email, and so no prior record, exists for it at all)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "same upstream trigger call" (FR-015) defined precisely enough at the requirements level (e.g.
      which field identifies it), or is this left entirely to the data model? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do FR-007, FR-011, and User Story 2's own framing paragraph state the reshare-gating condition
      identically? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-011] — Resolved: all three were rewritten in the
      2026-11-24 clarify session to state the unified gate identically.
- [ ] CHK010 Does Acceptance Scenario 6 (three successive amendments) state or imply that the FR-011 gate
      remains satisfied across all three reshares, or is that assumption left unstated? [Consistency, Spec User
      Story 2 AC6]
- [x] CHK011 Is the "Trigger ShortCode List" Key Entity description consistent with the Terms section's
      definition of the same list, now that both apply to first-share and reshare? [Consistency] —
      Resolved: both rewritten in the 2026-11-24 clarify session to say the gate applies to both types.
- [x] CHK012 Does FR-016's logging requirement ("triggering/changed result shortCodes") specify what to log
      when a reshare is suppressed by the FR-011 gate (empty field vs. no log entry at all)? [Consistency, Gap] —
      Resolved: FR-016 now states SUPPRESSED logs the full current-state shortCode set, not an empty array.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can "exactly one email with the correct PDF" (User Story 1 Independent Test) be objectively
      verified without reference to implementation? [Measurability]
- [ ] CHK014 Is SC-003 ("teams can tell exactly what changed... without needing to open the case") measurable
      as written, or does it rely on subjective judgement of PDF content? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK015 Do User Story 2's acceptance scenarios test FR-011's gate in both directions (newly satisfied by
      an amendment, and newly failed by one), not only the "already satisfied" case? [Coverage, Spec User Story 2]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Is there an acceptance scenario for a reshare where the gate was satisfied on the original first
      share, but the amendment removes the only trigger shortCode present, leaving none? [Gap, Scenario Coverage]
- [ ] CHK017 Is there a scenario for a hearing with more than one offence where only one offence's shortCodes
      satisfy the FR-011 gate and the others do not? [Gap] (data-model.md's per-offence design has no
      corresponding spec-level acceptance scenario yet)
- [ ] CHK018 Are exception/error flows (e.g. a malformed trigger notification) addressed in User Scenarios, or
      only in Edge Cases? [Coverage]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Is "an offence present in the previous share's snapshot but absent from current state" documented
      as a spec-level edge case, or only as an open item in data-model.md/the implementation plan? [Gap,
      Traceability]
- [ ] CHK020 Does the spec define behavior for a hearing where ALL offences are removed between shares (not
      just one)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 Is a requirement stated for what happens if the Previous Share Snapshot itself is somehow missing
      or corrupted at read time, distinct from "no prior SENT share exists"? [Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK022 Are there measurable performance/latency expectations for email delivery (e.g. "within N minutes
      of share"), or is this intentionally left unspecified? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK023 Is a data-retention requirement stated for the Notification Record / audit trail (how long it is
      kept, if ever purged)? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK024 Are FR-016's logging/observability requirements specific enough to be machine-verifiable (exact
      field names), or only descriptive? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Is the assumption that `cp-gov-uk-notify-gateway`'s `ReplyTo` mechanism will reliably deliver a
      result event validated anywhere, or only assumed? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the assumption that PDF rendering cannot go live before `team/CHD-2786` merges reflected as a
      testable release gate anywhere, or only as prose? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK027 Is it documented what happens to in-flight/failed notifications if the separate story covering
      automatic retry (referenced in FR-017's resolution) is never delivered? [Assumption, Gap]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK028 Does the spec state whether FR-011's gate check and FR-009's "immediately preceding share" diff
      are evaluated against the same results source, or could they diverge? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK029 Is it stated whether FR-011's gate is re-evaluated before or after building the per-offence
      comparison content, where ordering could affect behavior when the gate is newly failed this reshare?
      [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009, §FR-011]
